title: Mypy infers strange types for unions of T | Wrapper[T]
author: fabiommendes
body_preview: Consider the ambiguous (yet somewhat useful) type: ` T | list[T]`. title: Possibility to type `tuple.__hash__` to only accept hashable items
author: jonathandung
body_preview: If a tuple contains unhashable entries, hashing it would raise `TypeError`. Is this possible to type? Currently, `tuple.__hash__` is just a regular method that returns `int`.  This initial idea comes to mind, but on second thought, it would likely break a lot of code:  ```python class tuple(Sequence[_T_co]):     def __hash__(self: tuple[Hashable, ...]) -> int: ... ```
